mapper.insert: INSERT INTO receipts (receipt_number, user_id, reporter_id, project_id, receipt_date, amount, type, description, file_path, file_hash, ocr_data, verification_status, verified_by, verified_at, reporter_name, payment_status, paid_amount, paid_at, paid_by, payment_method, finance_status, finance_verified_by, finance_verified_at, finance_comment, project_manager_status, project_manager_verified_by, project_manager_verified_at, project_manager_comment, manager_status, manager_verified_by, manager_verified_at, manager_comment, current_approval_level) VALUES (#{receiptNumber}, #{userId}, #{reporterId}, #{projectId}, #{receiptDate}, #{amount}, #{type}, #{description}, #{filePath}, #{fileHash}, #{ocrData}, #{verificationStatus}, #{verifiedBy}, #{verifiedAt}, #{reporterName}, #{paymentStatus}, #{paidAmount}, #{paidAt}, #{paidBy}, #{paymentMethod}, #{financeStatus}, #{financeVerifiedBy}, #{financeVerifiedAt}, #{financeComment}, #{projectManagerStatus}, #{projectManagerVerifiedBy}, #{projectManagerVerifiedAt}, #{projectManagerComment}, #{managerStatus}, #{managerVerifiedBy}, #{managerVerifiedAt}, #{managerComment}, #{currentApprovalLevel})
mapper.update: UPDATE receipts SET finance_status = #{financeStatus}, finance_verified_by = #{financeVerifiedBy}, finance_verified_at = #{financeVerifiedAt}, finance_comment = #{financeComment}, project_manager_status = #{projectManagerStatus}, project_manager_verified_by = #{projectManagerVerifiedBy}, project_manager_verified_at = #{projectManagerVerifiedAt}, project_manager_comment = #{projectManagerComment}, manager_status = #{managerStatus}, manager_verified_by = #{managerVerifiedBy}, manager_verified_at = #{managerVerifiedAt}, manager_comment = #{managerComment}, current_approval_level = #{currentApprovalLevel} WHERE id = #{id}
